correctness.rationale: Exact residue exclusion plus special-term check prevents selected sums. Exact modulo-four arithmetic-progression cover up to 5M is certified for all h>=2 by an affine endpoint stability lemma with verified quotient intercepts [-7,23] and exhaustive tests h=2..132; shifting the larger of two summands by M covers the infinite tail. Circular gap (1,4) has a unique occurrence, proving minimum period, and the exceptional 2g+2 forces the minimum preperiod. Independent simulation for h=2..13 confirms the formulation, but is not used as the infinite proof.
